text:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up: florist dropped a large bouquet + framed print for a guest arriving at 15:30 (name on slip: M. Reyes). Desk is tight — can someone confirm we should hold the art or put it in storage?

Rita (Front Desk): Logged as PKG-1205 (flowers) and ART-88 (framed print). Currently on the low table by the lobby couch. No calendar entry for 'Reyes'  anyone expecting them?

Lina: That might be for my meeting 'Partner intro  15:30'  host shows as Lina. Please badge them as 'Marina Reyes (Guest of Lina)'.

Aisha (People Ops): I'll pre-print a one-time badge and add a fragile sticker for the print. Also please note: Marina has mobility needs, can we reserve the armchair by the demo wall?

Rita (Front Desk): Fragile sticker applied. Flowers looking heavy  might need two hands. I've put the bouquet on a stool to keep it off the floor. Armchair near demo wall reserved and labeled "Guest seating - Marina Reyes".

Omar (Facilities): If you want the print out of the lobby, I can move it to Storage B shelf 2 so it doesn't block foot traffic. I'll also bring a hand truck in 5.

FlowersBot: PKG-1205 scanned at 14:42. Delivery note: "leave at reception". Photo id: flowers_1841234520.jpg.

Lina: Thanks  please do move the print to storage. Also can someone confirm if the guest needs access to guest parking? I mentioned curbside drop, but they might take a taxi.

Sam (People Ops): No parking request on the calendar. @Lina if you want me to book a visitor parking pass for 1 hour, I can do that now.

Lina: Yes please book one spot. Also the guest asked for tea (no caffeine). Could we have a small pot ready?

Rita (Front Desk): Noted: tea (decaf) request. I'll place a kettle near the reserved armchair and a small saucer of cookies (gluten-free option available).

Omar (Facilities): Print moved to Storage B2 and labeled ART-88 - fragile. Hand truck parked by Door 3.

Aisha (People Ops): Parking pass issued and emailed to Lina. Badge printed as 'Marina Reyes (Guest of Lina)' and will be ready at front desk.

Rita (Front Desk): Guest arrived 15:28. Checked in, ID scanned, signed form. Gave badge and directions to the armchair. Flowers and print secured in storage. All good. :white_check_mark:

Sam (People Ops): Awesome  thanks team. Quick follow-up poll: should we add a column to the vendor checklist to include "recipient name & host" to avoid future no-name drops? Reply with :+1: for yes or :thumbsdown: for no.

Lina: :+1: please add it.

Omar (Facilities): :+1: makes the delivery workflow easier.

Rita (Front Desk): :+1: saves us time confirming with vendors.

Aisha (People Ops): I'll update the checklist and ping vendor ops template after lunch.

Sam (People Ops): Thanks everyone  closing the loop.
